summary: The QuickEntryFindStudent page is used to search and select students for placement. It involves various controls and scripts to handle search operations, data display, and user interactions.
purpose: To facilitate the search and selection of students for placement based on certain criteria like last name, first name, student number, and consent program.

workflows.name: Search Students
steps: User enters search criteria (last name, first name, student number).
The system performs a search based on input criteria.
The system displays matching student records.

workflows.name: Select Students
steps: User views the list of students.
User clicks the add selected students button.
Selected student IDs and names are added to a list.

business_rules: ProgramID should be initialized based on QueryString, and defaults to passed-in program on first load.
Warning is displayed if program filter does not match the expected program ID.
validations: Search criteria must include at least one of last name, first name, or student number.
conditions: Panel visibility based on the presence of student matches.
Warning visibility if program filter does not match expected program.
system_behavior: Supports search with pagination and sorting.
Registers and utilizes client-side and server-side scripts for user interaction.
Handles page states for search and selection operations.
